connect.intro: A recorder is a PC with a GPU, CS2 and Steam that records highlight clips from this platform's demos. Add as many as you like: they share the work.
connect.step1: Install CS2 and sign in to Steam once, then switch Steam to offline mode. Every recorder can use the same Steam account.
connect.step2: Get at-worker (the auto-tournament-worker image, or the binary) on the PC. It needs ffmpeg, gamescope and PipeWire.
connect.step4: Start it with at-worker record. On its first job it runs a short benchmark, then it shows up under Recorders with its numbers.
connect.gaming: You can game on the same PC while it records, but the GPU is shared: clips with too many repeated frames are turned down and recorded again elsewhere, and a recorder that keeps failing is paused for 15 minutes.
